thread:
ana: quick slice for launch/webinar next Tue. marketing needs conservative headline numbers + a short appendix showing warmup sensitivity. ask: p95/p99 token latency, coldstart heatmap, 2 long-context tail checks, and delta vs float16 for quantized-n4.

sam: got it. region and artifacts?

ana: ap-southeast-1 this time (APAC webinar). artifacts: per-request latencies CSV, heatmap PNG, samples.json (6 per prompt), a short manifest with model revision hash + seeds + CLI snippet. exclude full KV dumps.

leo: traffic profile? how many QPS and duration?

ana: small conservative profile: 35 qps, 12 minutes measurement. include two warmup regimes labeled in the CSV: warmup=120s and warmup=300s. induce 4 coldstarts across the run. compare quantized-n4 vs float16 baseline.

maria: I need a one-sentence methodology blurb and a CSV header line for the slide deck. please tag dataset id and S3 path in manifest.

sam: plan: staging cluster run, seeds 19,73,211; run sequence: quantized-n4 (120s warmup -> meas 12m) then quantized-n4 (300s warmup -> meas 12m) then float16 baseline (300s warmup -> meas 12m). record token-level latencies and GPU util (lightweight). s3 prefix: s3://redwood-launch-artifacts/2912345678-apac-smoke/. will include reproducible CLI for docs.

leo: note: quantized-n4 historically shows warmup sensitivity; labeling both buckets is good. coldstarts will be induced by restarting pods at minutes 4, 7, 9, 11 of each measurement window.

sam: running now. will avoid KV dumps to keep artifacts small. I'll attach a manifest with exact model rev and seeds.

benchbot: Scheduled bench job rb-2912345678 on staging for 2024-09-12T10:00:00Z. ETA artifacts: ~50m after completion.

benchbot: rb-2912345678 RUNNING: executing sequence as requested.

benchbot: rb-2912345678 COMPLETE. Artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-launch-artifacts/2912345678-apac-smoke/{manifest.txt,latencies.csv,heatmap.png,samples.json,gpu-util.csv}.

benchbot: Summary (measurement windows):
- quantized-n4 (120s warmup): p95=90ms p99=280ms; coldstart first-token spike median ~1.05s.
- quantized-n4 (300s warmup): p95=74ms p99=195ms; coldstart first-token spike median ~0.62s.
- float16 baseline (300s warmup): p95=68ms p99=162ms.

maria: pulling artifacts. note: quantized-n4 p99 improves a lot with longer warmup — will call out in appendix and use 300s numbers for headline.

ana: please annotate manifest with a short sequencing note (we ran back-to-back to reduce infra drift) and include the exact CLI for reproducibility. also flag any p99 delta >20% vs our last-public run.

sam: quick diff vs last-public: quantized-n4 (300s) p99 is +6% — within tolerance. quantized-n4 (120s) p99 is +40% vs last-public 300s baseline, which is expected due to warmup. no immediate rerun planned.

leo: reproducible snippet for manifest to paste in docs:
```\nbench-run --model redwood/quantized-n4:rev-20240912-xyz789 --region ap-southeast-1 --qps 35 --warmup 120 --duration 720 --seeds 19,73,211 --out s3://redwood-launch-artifacts/2912345678-apac-smoke/120s/\nbench-run --model redwood/quantized-n4:rev-20240912-xyz789 --region ap-southeast-1 --qps 35 --warmup 300 --duration 720 --seeds 19,73,211 --out s3://redwood-launch-artifacts/2912345678-apac-smoke/300s/\nbench-run --model redwood/float16:rev-20240912-abc456 --region ap-southeast-1 --qps 35 --warmup 300 --duration 720 --seeds 19,73,211 --out s3://redwood-launch-artifacts/2912345678-apac-smoke/float16/\n```

maria: methodology blurb for blog (one sentence): "Runs executed on staging (ap-southeast-1) with seeds [19,73,211]; we measured two warmup regimes (120s and 300s) to illustrate warmup sensitivity; artifacts include per-request latencies at token granularity, heatmaps, and samples."

ana: perfect. marketing will use the 300s numbers in the press materials and put the 120s bucket in the appendix to explain tail sensitivity. thanks team :sparkles:
